create_lm_context_window_dataset: create an LMContextWindowDataset wrapping a MonolingualDataset with a configurable context window and padding index
collate_samples_with_context: collate language model samples with accumulated context tokens prepended to each batch item
review_collater_method: review the collater method that prepends previous tokens and pads to a fixed context window size
test_ordered_indices: test the ordered_indices method that returns non-shuffled indices to preserve context across samples
summarize_lm_context_window_dataset: summarize the LMContextWindowDataset class that wraps a MonolingualDataset to provide additional context for evaluation
